To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the process of insight discovery is not linear and is iterative, (ii) the process of data exploration is not a single step process but a multi-step process, (iii) users are interested in visual representations that provide them with an overview of the entire data set, (iv) users are not always interested in the most detailed view of the data, and (v) users are not satisfied with the visual representations that provide a detailed view of the entire data.
